verified: ESA confirmed that BepiColombo's signal was acquired at 01:02 UTC on Nov. 22 and that the spacecraft was in orbit around Mercury after a planned 37-minute orbit-insertion burn; ESA later said the burn was shorter than planned because of a software issue, according to NASA Spaceflight's account and ESA statements cited by Wikipedia and European Spaceflight.
unconfirmed: the exact nature of the software fault, how much of the burn was lost, the resulting orbit parameters, and the corrective maneuver plan; the statement that little correction will be needed rests on mission-team assessments, and no independent orbital tracking or detailed ESA/JAXA anomaly report is cited.

verified: ESA 于 11 月 22 日 01:02 UTC 确认收到 BepiColombo 信号，探测器已进入水星轨道；ESA 随后表示，探测器在入轨机动中“因软件问题，推进器点火时间短于计划”，原定 37 分钟的点火因此被缩短（ESA 说法，经 NASA Spaceflight、European Spaceflight 及维基百科转述）。
unconfirmed: 软件故障的具体性质与成因、实际点火时长与由此产生的轨道偏差、以及“只需很少修正即可完成任务”的判断，目前均仅来自 ESA 方面声明与转述，没有独立测量或第三方轨道数据佐证；信号比预期晚数小时才捕获的原因，ESA 也未作说明。

titles.en: BepiColombo reaches Mercury orbit but short thruster burn points to software glitch
titles.zh: BepiColombo 进入水星轨道，软件问题缩短点火时间
